title: Item ammo rack subsystem (static attributes)
description: Static attributes of an item ammo rack: item container size. The item-to-AmmoBelt mapping is not implemented yet, so this type currently provides the container and its own cook-off only (WIP).

$schema.description: Path of this JSON Schema, used for editor completion and validation.

basic_durability.description: Durability limit. Reaching zero destroys the rack and detonates its container contents; it recovers at 30% of the limit.

pass_damage.description: Whether damage is passed on to the subsystem host.

limit_damage.description: Whether passed damage is limited to the remaining subsystem durability.

hidden.description: Whether the subsystem is hidden from the HUD.
